title: Capture and Excision: Five Observations on Composition-Layer Authorial Suppression
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A compressed evidence receipt distilling the longer field-observation paper on source-reported Google AI Mode adoption of the “Socrates as Orthonym” framework. The record presents five observations and a transcript excerpt in a form designed to travel farther than the full apparatus.

Its central asymmetry is that the composition surface reportedly preserved the upstream Pessoa lineage and linked the downstream Zenodo artifact while omitting Lee Sharks, the author who produced the bridge, and separately redirected a direct name query toward shark-related entities. The paper calls this **capture and excision**: conceptual structure can be composed while the present authorial node is removed. The platform outputs and timing are documented claims of the record, not independently reproduced measurements.
reading: Growth -> Direction -> Proof -> Transmutation -> Touch -> Play
